Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a right-sided pneumothorax (visible pleural line and absent lung markings on the right) and pneumopericardium, characterized by a radiolucent halo of air surrounding the cardiac silhouette that does not extend superiorly around the aortic knuckle (distinguishing it from pneumomediastinum). This pattern is consistent with a complication such as erosion from a cavitating lung lesion into the pericardial space.
